method: 2026-10-30 cross-spec review. review.jsonl grades every open row (verdict, tier, entry point, proof kind, cross-spec interfaces, overlap, gap, fix). orphan_verified lists VERIFIED rows whose tested module has no public item named by non-test code under src/. group_summary is the reviewer summary for the review group that held this spec.

# Group x01: EG-DURABLE-KERNEL (294 rows graded; 287 SPECIFIED, 7 LANDED)
## 1. Verdict and tier counts
- Verdicts: THIN 133, OWNER 73, READY 34, DUP 28, EXISTS 11, BLANK 11, DECISION 4.
- Tiers: sonnet 136, opus 136, vllm 16, bind 6. Only 34 rows (12%) are one-slice READY.
- The spec holds 428 rows; 133 are VERIFIED (50 crate, 49 facade, 17 served). Open rows are mostly later additions: templated Model/Behavior/Wiring/Refusal/Evidence/Hot-path children (R035, R043, R091-R098, R700, R750-R752, R850-R852).
- 73 OWNER rows (R087-R098, R011, R082.11) belong in other specs; they inflate this spec.
## 2. Cross-spec contracts
| consumer row | provider spec | missing provider row (proposed text) |
|---|---|---|
| DECISION-ENGINE (memory authority), FEDERATED-QUERY (R101 memory admission), DURABLE-KERNEL-R028.1 | DURABLE-KERNEL-R085 | R085.1 must create `MemorySnapshot`/`SyncMemorySnapshot` (absent from src/ and crates/). Consumers call R085 "existing"; reword to "to be created" and land R085.1 first. |
| DECISION-ENGINE-R044 (A2A routing reads peer table) | DURABLE-KERNEL-R851 | R044 declares no `peer.list` read. Add: "R044 reads AgentPeer records through served `peer.list` (DURABLE-KERNEL-R851.3)." agent_peer.rs has no production caller. |
| EG-INGEST-WORKER-R604.1 (SchedulerConfig, WorkerRegistry) | DURABLE-KERNEL-R074/R076 | R604.1 redefines both types in `ingest_lanes.rs`; add "imports crates/eg-types scheduler_config.rs and worker_registry.rs; defines only Lane, QueueClass, LaneMetrics". |

| EG-ENGINE-PARITY-R003 (batch extends version-checked writes) | DURABLE-KERNEL-R084 | R084.3 cites crates/eg-jobs/src/store.rs:2537 (blank line; job plane, not graph write). Name the MutationBatch version check. |
| EG-ORCH-VOCAB-R081 (uses R078/R081 stamps) | DURABLE-KERNEL-R078-R081 | Declared on both sides, but R609.2 defines the same stamp: see section 3. |
| DURABLE-KERNEL-R042.5 (listeners) | R860.* | Declared; but R042.5 cannot start before R860 lands all four. |
| DURABLE-KERNEL-R030/R039.x pending-call | ARBORA-* | No Arbora row declares consuming `IssueHostStartGrant` or the paired pending consumption. Add ARBORA rows. |

- Sides correctly paired: EG-SCM -> R057/R089.1, UNIFIED-DATA-PLANE -> R024, FEDERATED-QUERY -> R024.1/.3, R101 consumers, EG-BRANCH-MERGE -> R003/R009/R019/R029.
## 3. Overlaps and duplicate authority
- Bitemporal stamp: R078-R081 vs R609.1-R609.6 (`versioning.rs` absent). Owner: R078-R081 for served methods, R609.1 for types only; move KgCommit/KgDiff to EG-BRANCH-MERGE.
- SchedulerConfig / WorkerRegistry: R074/R076 (files exist) vs EG-INGEST-WORKER-R604.1. Owner: DURABLE-KERNEL.
- Lane-aware claim: R071.600 vs EG-INGEST-WORKER-R604.2. Owner: R604.
- Task queue vs dispatch queue vs bus vs topic log: R072, R750, R095.1000-1005 (agent bus), R850 (topic log; crates/eg-durable/src/topic.rs already has TopicCursor). Owner: one store, R850 plus R072; delete R095.1000+.
- Analytics payload cap: R082.3 vs EG-PLACEMENT-R003 (closes it). Owner: PLACEMENT.
- Mirror registration: R024.4/R100.3 vs EG-UNIFIED-DATA-PLANE-R024. Owner: UNIFIED-DATA-PLANE registry, this spec drivers.
- Benchmark records: R042.1/.100 vs EG-ENGINE-PARITY-R005. Owner: ENGINE-PARITY.
- Identifier registry: R094.700/.701 vs EG-IDENTITY-R006. Owner: IDENTITY.
- Wire listeners: R035/R860 vs ENGINE-PARITY and public-engine-contract. Owner: R860 for listeners, R035 per-capability children only.
- Misfiled families (73 OWNER rows): finance (R057.1, R092, R093) -> finance-primitives; reasoner (R097, R098) -> federated-query; changeset review (R087) -> source-changesets; rules/verdicts (R088, R089) -> decision-engine/meristem; schema import (R090) -> typed-packs; policy source (R091) -> source-authority; inbox (R095) -> ARBORA; CI gate (R011) -> pipelines.
## 4. Hot paths
- Entry points: `ApplyMutation` (src/mutation_apply.rs), `ApplyChangeEnvelope` (src/audit/control_lines.rs:167), `MultiGraphBatchUpdate` (dispatch/change_envelope/multi_graph.rs), `ClaimWorkItem`, `IssueHostStartGrant`, `SupersedeEdge`, `EvictLRU`/`GetNodeProperties`, `MineAssociate` executor_loop.rs, pgwire/bolt_wire/redis_wire/s3 listeners in src/main.rs.
- Rows that never reach one: R071 (types, no TaskQueue RPC), R092-R098 (no crate named), R700 (python test path tests/durable/ missing), R750-R752 (benchmark only), R851-R852 (no served method), R083.* (kvcache is a feature-gated crate with no served call proven).
## 5. VERIFIED isolation spot check (crate-only proof; src/ and other crates' production code grepped)
No production consumer found (only defining file and its tests) for:
1. R033 `HotStoreEngine` crates/eg-types/src/hot_store_engine.rs: no caller.
2. R034 `CrossStoreScope` cross_store_scope.rs: no caller.
3. R036 `MirrorSinkKind` mirror_sink.rs: no caller in src/ or crates/*/src (only tests in eg-plan).
4. R037 `WorkloadClass` workload_class.rs: no caller.
5. R040 `PipelineBatch` pipeline_batch.rs: no caller.
6. R041 `PlanCacheKey::lookup` plan_cache_key.rs:49: no caller outside its tests.
7. R032 `fast_path` fast_path.rs: matches in src are test names only.
8. R027 control_lease/governed_change tests: audit/control_lines.rs formats the methods but never calls the eg-types policy functions I grepped.
Connected: R001/R004 outbox (eg-transaction claim.rs, used by the outbox runtime), R006 physical storage, R054/R013 raft harness. R046 geo and R022 isolation not traced. Pure eg-types contract modules (R033-R041) are verified by unit tests of types nobody uses.
## 6. Five most common gaps
1. No production call site / served proof (R071, R750-R752, R851, R852, R100.2).
2. Stale or wrong anchors: main.rs:1154/1367/1391/1461, eg-jobs store.rs:2537, recovery/validate.rs path (R860, R084.3, R063.2).
3. Test paths that do not exist or use python in a Rust repo: tests/durable/*.py (R700, R820), tests/safe_eviction_read_through.rs.
4. Templated children with no file, symbol or value (R035.2-.6, R043.1-.6, R091-R098).
5. Row owned by another repo/spec (73 rows).
## 7. Decisions needed (recommended first)
1. Reparent or delete the 73 OWNER rows and 11 BLANK rows. Recommend: move to owning specs, delete templated children.
2. R085: create the memory contract before any consumer cites it. Recommend: land R085.1 and rename "existing" to "to be created" in R028.1 and consumers.
3. One queue/log: recommend R850 topic log + eg-jobs queue behind R072; drop R095.1000-1005 and R750 dispatch queue duplicates.
4. Bitemporal: R609 types only; R078-R081 served; commit/diff to branch-merge.
5. R084 conflict check: recommend the MutationBatch version check, strategies Refuse/Merge, rename `resolve_conflict` (clashes with the query-planner symbol).
6. R053 AVX2: recommend a labelled x86 runner (homelab has no AVX2) or retire.
7. Isolated eg-types modules (R033-R041): either wire (served setting or planner call) or mark isolated; do not leave VERIFIED.
